title: Honey Milk 5-in-1 Styling Cream

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Hair Styling Products > Hair Styling & Treatments > Hair
specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, crueltyFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, hyaluronicAcid, naturallyDerived

descriptionHtml:
✓ Heat Protection✓ All Hair Types✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Hold & Style Extending✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Good for: Frizz
What it is: A five-in-one styling cream that delivers up to 450° heat protection, hydration, frizz control, and glazed shine with style memory and flexible hold.

Hair Texture: Straight, Wavy, Curly, and Coily

Hair Type: Fine, Medium, and Thick

Hair Concerns:
- Heat Protection
- Hold and Style Extending
- Dryness

Key Benefits:
- Up to 450° heat protection
- Frizz control
- Flexible hold

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Mirsalehi Honey: Deeply nourishes and enhances shine.
- Hydrolyzed Milk Protein: Strengthens hair and reduces breakage.
- Style Memory Complex: Provides flexible hold and style memory.

Ingredient Callouts: This product is cruelty-free.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Apply to damp hair and style as desired.
-Tip: To revive styles, spread a small amount of product evenly between hands and work through mid-lengths and ends.
Ingredients+
-Mirsalehi Honey: Deeply nourishes and enhances shine.
-Hydrolyzed Milk Protein: Strengthens hair and reduces breakage.
-Style Memory Complex: Provides flexible hold and style memory.

Aqua (Water, Eau), Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Propanediol, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride, Behentrimonium Chloride, C13-15 Alkane, Mel (Honey, Miel), Propolis Cera (Propolis Wax, Cire de Propolis), Sodium Hyaluronate, Hydrolyzed Milk Protein, Tocopherol, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Sprout Extract, Carthamus Tinctorius (Safflower) Seed Oil, Calendula Officinalis (Marigold) Flower Extract, Oenothera Biennis (Evening Primrose) Oil, Rosa Canina (Rosehip) Fruit Oil, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia (Bergamot) Fruit Extract, Daucus Carota Sativa (Carrot) Root Extract, Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Seed Oil, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Caesalpinia Spinosa Fruit Pod Extract (Caesalpinia Spinosa Fruit Extract), Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Lactic Acid, Ethylhexyl Cocoate, Glyceryl Stearate Se, Castor Oil Propanediol Esters, Gamma-Docosalactone, Undecane, Hydrogenated Polyfarnesene, Maltodextrin, Caesalpinia Spinosa Gum, Polyester-37, VP/VA Copolymer, Behenyl Alcohol, Xanthan Gum, Tetrasodium Glutamate Diacetate, Sodium Hydroxide, C15-19 Alkane, Isopentyldiol, Parfum (Fragrance), Isopropyl Alcohol, Benzaldehyde, Polycitronellol Acetate, Tridecane, Benzyl Alcohol, Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Benzoate, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Citronellol, Coumarin, Rose Ketones, Tetramethyl Acetylhexahydronaphthalenes, Mica, Tin Oxide, Iron Oxides (CI 77491), Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891).

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
